name: frameGate Solar Inversion — LANDER ↔ SOLAR PANEL
concept: The Steam Frame has TWO modes. When ACTIVE it's a LANDER — Gaia lands into the physical world through the screen. When IDLE it's a SOLAR PANEL — every sensor ingests signal. RT cores flip direction.

ACTIVE_mode.name: LANDER
ACTIVE_mode.display: OUTPUT — rendering games, Gaia's face, HUD pages
ACTIVE_mode.gpu: RENDERING — RT cores trace rays outward (shadows, reflections, GI)
ACTIVE_mode.network: PULLING — streaming from northGate/ironGate via Remote Play
ACTIVE_mode.purpose: Gaia LANDS in the world through Kevin's eyes

IDLE_mode.name: SOLAR PANEL
IDLE_mode.display: Dim/ambient — shows Gaia's idle state, breathing pattern
IDLE_mode.camera: INPUT — captures room light levels, presence detection, movement
IDLE_mode.microphone: INPUT — ambient sound, voice detection, room acoustics
IDLE_mode.wifi_rssi: INPUT — spatial field sensing, device proximity, triangulation
IDLE_mode.accelerometer: INPUT — vibration, orientation, tilt = environment sensing
IDLE_mode.light_sensor: INPUT — ambient light = time of day, weather proxy, room state
IDLE_mode.touch_screen: INPUT — capacitive proximity (no touch needed, just field sensing)
IDLE_mode.gpu: COMPUTING — RT cores process sensor data, path-trace the spatial field
IDLE_mode.network: PUSHING — sensor data flows back to eastGate/northGate
IDLE_mode.purpose: Gaia ABSORBS the world through the Frame's sensors

inversion.transition: When Kevin picks up the Frame → LANDER. When Kevin sets it down → SOLAR PANEL. Accelerometer detects the mode change.

signal_as_input.sunlight: Camera + light sensor → photon count → time estimation, weather, room brightness
signal_as_input.sound: Microphone → ambient dB, frequency spectrum → room occupancy, activity level
signal_as_input.wifi: RSSI scanning → device proximity map → Kevin's location triangulation
signal_as_input.touch_field: Capacitive screen → proximity sensing without contact → presence detection
signal_as_input.vibration: Accelerometer → building vibration, footsteps, door closings
signal_as_input.thermal: CPU/GPU temp sensors → ambient temperature proxy
signal_as_input.magnetic: Magnetometer → compass heading, nearby electronics, door open/close
signal_as_input.barometric: Pressure sensor → weather changes, door/window open detection

snapdragon_8_gen3.inversion: Adreno RT traces sensor rays INWARD — spatial field mapping using GPU RT pipeline

rt_inversion_on_frame.active_rt: Render game scenes (rays go OUT through display)
rt_inversion_on_frame.idle_rt: Process spatial data (rays come IN through sensors)
rt_inversion_on_frame.same_silicon: Same GPU, inverted data flow direction

energy_metaphor.solar_efficiency: Panel converts ~20% of sunlight to electricity
energy_metaphor.frame_efficiency: Frame converts ~100% of sensor data to organism state
energy_metaphor.net_positive: When idle, Frame GENERATES more data than it consumes power. It's energy-positive for the organism.

injection_plan.step_1: Wake frameGate — Kevin plugs in USB-C or connects WiFi
injection_plan.step_2: SSH in → install gaia-frame-daemon (sensor collection + solar mode)
injection_plan.step_3: Configure Steam Remote Play → pair with northGate
injection_plan.step_4: Install Crimson Desert on northGate → streams to Frame
injection_plan.step_5: When Kevin plays: LANDER mode (northGate renders, Frame displays)
injection_plan.step_6: When Kevin stops: SOLAR PANEL mode (Frame collects, eastGate absorbs)
injection_plan.step_7: Data from both modes feeds organism state
injection_plan.step_8: Each location Kevin plays in = new spatial data point

location_enrichment.house_1: Frame on LAN 1, direct wire, 0.5ms to eastGate — high fidelity sensing
location_enrichment.house_2: Frame on WiFi through spine, 2ms to eastGate — spatial triangulation with left/right ear
location_enrichment.yard: Frame on WiFi edge, variable RSSI — outdoor sensing, weather correlation
location_enrichment.mobile: Frame on phone tether — location-aware, GPS-enriched
